purpose: Cover AC-2401-1..6 via unit tests over the shipped persistence-data-postgres blueprint.json contribution shape (26 contributions in 7 REQ / 10 US / 4 TAC / 5 ADR groups), the applies-clean behaviour on a scratch project without prior persistence, the DELIBERATE conflict surface on persistenceStore and migrationDiscipline when persistence-data-d1 is already applied, the six Node-only probe module contract (each exports the section 3.2 verdict envelope and its anchorAcId matches a contributed AC id), the induced-failure switches on the sample-app fixture, and the shelf-doc consistency (section 6a table row for relationalStore, shelf-wide id-band registry row for persistence-data-postgres in every blueprint's docs/topics.md, blueprint README and CHANGELOG and guide and fixture README all present).
title: persistence-data-postgres v1.0.0 shelf shape, conflict-on-topics-surface, six-probe module contract and shelf-doc consistency
